# Pascal's Triangle II.

@example Row 5 is [1,5,10,10,5,1], so row 6 is 1, 1 + 5, 5 + 10, 10 + 10, 10 + 5, 5 + 1, 1.
6
=> [1,6,15,20,15,6,1]

@example Row 9 has 10 numbers; the middle two are both 56 + 70 from row 8.
9
=> [1,9,36,84,126,126,84,36,9,1]

@example Row 2 is the first with a number between its 1s.
2
=> [1,2,1]
